verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own access controls: advanced permissions let administrators control who can view or modify sensitive equity data, and a secure data room shares diligence materials. That plausibly lets a company give outside parties limited, non-admin access to equity data. Nothing shows this extends to authorized third parties such as law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers, or to programmatic delegated access for developers. Missing for 10: explicit third-party or delegated-access roles, API/OAuth-scoped tokens for integrators, documentation of how permissions are scoped, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
